name: shoot.add_idea
description: An idea joins this shoot, last in the order, and leaves the one it was on. It lands first, then a planned shoot left empty goes, so an empty planned shoot it joins is not lost.
sql:
with emptied as (
  delete from brandbase.shoots s
  where s.brand_id = :brand and s.origin = 'planned' and s.id <> :id
    and cardinality(array(select i from unnest(s.idea_ids) i where i <> all (array[:ideaId]))) = 0
  returning s.id
),
taken as (
  update brandbase.shoots s set idea_ids = array(select i from unnest(s.idea_ids) i where i <> all (array[:ideaId])),
    version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  where s.brand_id = :brand and s.id <> :id and s.idea_ids && array[:ideaId]
    and s.id not in (select id from emptied)
  returning s.id
),
joined as (
  update brandbase.shoots s set idea_ids = array_remove(s.idea_ids, :ideaId) || :ideaId, version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
  returning s.*
)
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(j), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) from brandbase.crew c where c.shoot_id = j.id), '[]')) as result from joined j
